plan.notes: Official Greensboro College 2026-2027 Undergraduate Academic Catalog. The catalog publishes degree requirements with no official semester sequence for this program — collected as a single requirements block (requirements_only). This plan covers the major requirements only (Required Courses plus Required Related Courses as printed); Greensboro College requires a minimum of 124 total credit hours for the degree, the balance being general education, all-college/disciplinary requirements and free electives, which are not part of this major block. Where the catalog prints only a block subtotal for a choose-from group, the group is recorded as one choice slot at the printed subtotal with the options named in the choice note; no per-option credits were invented. Catalog states biology majors must complete all courses in one of the concentrations offered; this is the general Biology major table (catalog p.148).

courses.title: Choose four (at least one from each group)
courses.choice_note: Choose four courses (at least one from each group), 16 credits as printed. Group A: BIO 2240 Invertebrate Zoology & Laboratory; BIO 2300 Human Anatomy & Physiology I & Laboratory; BIO 2400 Human Anatomy & Physiology II & Laboratory; BIO 3300 Comparative Vertebrate Morphology & Laboratory. Group B: BIO 3200 Evolution; BIO 3400 Ecology & Laboratory; BIO 3450 Environmental Science & Laboratory; BIO 3480 Conservation Biology; BIO 3490 Aquatic Ecology & Laboratory.

courses.title: Choose three of these courses
courses.choice_note: Choose three, 12 credits as printed: BIO 3350 Infectious Diseases & Laboratory; BIO 3600 Developmental Biology & Laboratory; BIO 3650 Cell Biology & Laboratory; BIO 3670 Genetics & Laboratory; BIO 3690 Microbiology & Laboratory.

courses.title: Internship
courses.choice_note: Choose one, 2 credits as printed: BIO 3800 Internship; BIO 4850 Research.

courses.choice_note: Required Related: choose one, 4 credits: MAT 2060 Calculus I; MAT 2360 Statistics.
